name: WooCommerce
description: Typed WooCommerce REST v3 catalog, stock, orders, refunds, customers, coupons, shipping, tax and reports with bounded requests and confirmed writes.

permissions.description: One bounded HTTPS request to explicit store origin using externally supplied REST API key/secret via profile username/password or named secrets. Confirmed writes, no automatic retries, redirects, ambient discovery or credential query parameters.

definitions.name: WooCommerce Get Products
definitions.documentation: WooCommerce Get Products: GET /wp-json/wc/v3/products/:id. Explicit canonical HTTPS storeOrigin; root installation only. Connection profile config.storeOrigin and credentials.username (consumer key), credentials.password (consumer secret), or named WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY / WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET secrets. HTTP Basic header only. Mutations require confirmMutation=true. Numeric $retries=0 only. Exactly one request, no pagination/retry/redirect or returned URL following. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition. definitions.name: WooCommerce Create Product
definitions.documentation: WooCommerce Create Product: POST /wp-json/wc/v3/products. Explicit canonical HTTPS storeOrigin; root installation only. Connection profile config.storeOrigin and credentials.username (consumer key), credentials.password (consumer secret), or named WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY / WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET secrets. HTTP Basic header only. Mutations require confirmMutation=true. Numeric $retries=0 only. Exactly one request, no pagination/retry/redirect or returned URL following. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition. definitions.documentation: WooCommerce Update Product: PUT /wp-json/wc/v3/products/:id. Explicit canonical HTTPS storeOrigin; root installation only. Connection profile config.storeOrigin and credentials.username (consumer key), credentials.password (consumer secret), or named WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY / WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET secrets. HTTP Basic header only. Mutations require confirmMutation=true. Numeric $retries=0 only. Exactly one request, no pagination/retry/redirect or returned URL following. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition. definitions.name: WooCommerce List Variations
definitions.documentation: WooCommerce List Variations: GET /wp-json/wc/v3/products/:productId/variations. Explicit canonical HTTPS storeOrigin; root installation only. Connection profile config.storeOrigin and credentials.username (consumer key), credentials.password (consumer secret), or named WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY / WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET secrets. HTTP Basic header only. Mutations require confirmMutation=true. Numeric $retries=0 only. Exactly one request, no pagination/retry/redirect or returned URL following. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition. definitions.documentation: WooCommerce Create Variation: POST /wp-json/wc/v3/products/:productId/variations. Explicit canonical HTTPS storeOrigin; root installation only. Connection profile config.storeOrigin and credentials.username (consumer key), credentials.password (consumer secret), or named WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY / WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET secrets. HTTP Basic header only. Mutations require confirmMutation=true. Numeric $retries=0 only. Exactly one request, no pagination/retry/redirect or returned URL following. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition. Connection profile config.storeOrigin and credentials.username (consumer key), credentials.password (consumer secret), or named WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY / WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET secrets. HTTP Basic header only. Mutations require confirmMutation=true. Numeric $retries=0 only. Exactly one request, no pagination/retry/redirect or returned URL following. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition. definitions.name: WooCommerce List Orders
definitions.documentation: WooCommerce List Orders: GET /wp-json/wc/v3/orders. Explicit canonical HTTPS storeOrigin; root installation only. Connection profile config.storeOrigin and credentials.username (consumer key), credentials.password (consumer secret), or named WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY / WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET secrets. HTTP Basic header only. Mutations require confirmMutation=true. Numeric $retries=0 only. Exactly one request, no pagination/retry/redirect or returned URL following. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition. definitions.documentation: WooCommerce Update Order: PUT /wp-json/wc/v3/orders/:id. Explicit canonical HTTPS storeOrigin; root installation only. Connection profile config.storeOrigin and credentials.username (consumer key), credentials.password (consumer secret), or named WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY / WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET secrets. HTTP Basic header only. Mutations require confirmMutation=true and confirmFinancial=true. Numeric $retries=0 only. Exactly one request, no pagination/retry/redirect or returned URL following. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. definitions.documentation: WooCommerce List Coupons: GET /wp-json/wc/v3/coupons. Explicit canonical HTTPS storeOrigin; root installation only. Connection profile config.storeOrigin and credentials.username (consumer key), credentials.password (consumer secret), or named WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY / WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET secrets. HTTP Basic header only. Mutations require confirmMutation=true. Numeric $retries=0 only. Exactly one request, no pagination/retry/redirect or returned URL following. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition. definitions.name: WooCommerce Get Setting Option
definitions.documentation: WooCommerce Get Setting Option: GET /wp-json/wc/v3/settings/:groupId/:optionId. Explicit canonical HTTPS storeOrigin; root installation only. Connection profile config.storeOrigin and credentials.username (consumer key), credentials.password (consumer secret), or named WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY / WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET secrets. HTTP Basic header only. Mutations require confirmMutation=true. Numeric $retries=0 only. Exactly one request, no pagination/retry/redirect or returned URL following. Page 1..1000000, size 1..100, default 10; other collections at most 100. Total deadline 100..30000ms includes profile, secrets, decode and cleanup. Limits: 256 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 24. Unknown response fields omitted; private errors redacted. IDs are safe integers, decimal money is preserved as strings. API key read/write permissions and associated user capabilities apply. No live store verification or token acquisition.
